types.name: Difference series
types.description: A list of numbers where the gaps between neighbouring terms follow a pattern (same gap, gaps growing by a fixed amount, or gaps of gaps); asks for the next or missing number.

types.name: Multiply-and-add series
types.description: Numbers that grow or shrink fast because each term is the previous one multiplied or divided and then a number added or subtracted (×2 + 1, ×3 − 2, alternate ×2 and +7, or built from the previous two terms).

types.name: Squares, cubes and primes
types.description: A number series whose terms or gaps are perfect squares, cubes or prime numbers, or forms like n² + 1, n³ − n, p² with primes p.

types.name: Alternate (two-in-one) series
types.description: A number or letter series where odd-position and even-position terms form two separate series, or the operations repeat in a cycle of two or three (−3, −8, −3, −8).

types.name: Wrong term
types.description: A complete series is given and the question asks which term is wrong, incorrect or does not belong to the series.

types.name: Letter and letter-cluster series
types.description: A series of single capital letters or letter-clusters such as ACE, BDF, CEG, ? where the letters move forward or backward in the alphabet; no blanks and no numbers.

types.name: Fill the blanks (repeating letters)
types.description: A long row of letters with underscores (blanks) such as "a _ c a b _ a _ c"; asks which letters fill the blanks so a block repeats.

types.name: Alphanumeric series
types.description: Each term mixes letters with numbers, or capital with small letters (A1Z, C3X, XF 11, qDx); each part follows its own rule.

types.name: Missing number in a grid
types.description: Numbers arranged in rows, columns or a table (often 3 × 3) with one cell missing; asks for the number that completes the pattern.

types.name: Figure series
types.description: A row of pictures (figures) that change step by step; asks which figure comes next or replaces the question mark.
